item.title: Court documents indicate Kwame Kilpatrick strikes deal to pay more than $800k in restitution
item.description: Former Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick and federal prosecutors have come to an agreement on $823,649.09 Kilpatrick owes in restitution following his conviction on corruption charges.

item.title: Dearborn nonprofit distributing tracking devices for kids with autism, vulnerable adults
item.description: Mona Alaouie, the co-founder of Blue Hands United for Autism in Dearborn, turned pain into purpose by launching "Yousif's Guiding Hands.”

item.title: Milford Independent Cinema saved from closure after community rallies with donations
item.description: The Milford Independent Cinema will remain open after an overwhelming wave of community support helped the nonprofit theater raise the funds needed to avoid permanent closure.
